messages:
sara (support): Customer 'acme-prod' reporting embed vectors/sec dropped ~70% starting ~03:12 UTC while tokens/sec looks stable. They see occasional 429s and tail latency. dashboard: https://dash.redwood.ai/acme/embeds?range=15m :warning:

tim (eng-runtime): Can you paste a sample request + model variant? Any recent rollouts?

sara (support): Example request they reported: 
```curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings 
 -H 'Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED>' 
 -d '{"model":"embed-lite-v2","input":["..."],"batch_size":64}'```
They use batch_size ~64, seq_len up to 512, dim=768. Last known good at ~02:50 UTC.

lin (eng-ml): Model is embed-lite-v2 (ptq8 q4-ish). Check rollout history and kvcache eviction logs. I see a canary->prod promotion around 03:00 UTC. Could be kernel/quant changes interacting with batching.

deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] rollout embed-lite-v2: canary -> 100% at 2024-11-12T03:00:12Z by @tim

mike (infra): Infra look: GPU p99 util jumped to 95-97% at 03:11, queue depth spiked from baseline 12 -> ~180, scheduler reported backpressure. Observed many pods with gpu_queue_depth high and kernel wait. kvcache eviction rate increased sharply.

lin (eng-ml): Hypothesis: larger effective batch window on production + quantized kernel change -> KV cache thrashing / lock contention -> stalls per request. That would reduce measured vectors/sec (end-to-end embedding throughput) while token stream/scheduling metrics may still report token/sec differently.

tim (eng-runtime): Repro plan: 1) run loadgen mimicking customer batch_size=64 and seq_len=512 against canary with batch_window_ms=25; 2) enable KV_CACHE_DEBUG=1 to surface evictions/lock waits; 3) compare vec_rate vs tok_rate and gpu_queue_depth.

sara (support): Customer ok to run test, wants minimal disruption. They asked for rollback plan if worsens.

mike (infra): I can rollback canary to embed-lite-v1 in ~5m. Proposed mitigation: temporarily lower batch_window_ms to 10ms on canary and observe. If vec_rate recovers, we keep config until full fix. Watch metrics: embedding_vectors/sec, gpu_queue_depth, kvcache_evictions/s.

lin (eng-ml): Metrics/thresholds to watch: "vec_rate" >= 80% of baseline, kvcache_evictions < 5/s, gpu_queue_depth < 40, kvcache_lock_wait_ms < 5ms. If any breach, rollback.

anna (customer-success): Pinged customer for 03:25 UTC test window. I'll coordinate and capture request logs.

tim (eng-runtime): Quick log snippet from canary pod during spike: ```WARN kvcache: lock_wait=12.3ms evict_count=48 batch_size=64 seq_len=512 model=embed-lite-v2 pod=canary-3```

sara (support): Filing ticket #12345 with these repro steps and proposed rollback. Will update after the 03:25 test. Thanks all :thumbsup:
